**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected OperationsTM Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

**You should apply if:**

* You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
* You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
* You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

**In this role, you will:**

* Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
* Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
* Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention.
* Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
* Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
* Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
* Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
* Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
* Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

**Minimum requirements for this role.**

* 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
* Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
* Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
* Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
* Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
* Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
* Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
* Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
* Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
* Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

**Total Rewards**

You will be working closely with other regional portfolio operations managers with your colleagues from our in-house cleaning and security teams, ensuring a seamless and efficient portfolio oversight which may stretch across all three service streams.

· Responsibility for onsite induction and managing probationary periods of employees in line with company policies.

· Carry out annual appraisals in a timely manner with all direct reports, providing constructive feedback and support for professional growth.

SERVICE EXELLENCE

· Strengthen the internal reputation of Front of House by providing an exceptional service to employees, customers and users of the service.

· Deliver events and activations across the portfolio, thereby contributing to Savills’ and our clients’ ESG goals and customer satisfaction. Feed back into the business stream the results of these initiatives for central ESG reporting.

· Ensure a strong focus on service excellence is threaded into every aspect of the department.

· Continuously develop and innovate the standard of our services.

· Maintain the visual aspect of the Front of House service by managing standards such as Uniform and general presentation, it is your responsibility to ensure all teams are presentable and professional in appearance.

· Where there is a site based Reception Manager, ensure that this individual is confident to chair and take minutes on Monthly & Quarterly meetings. Where there is no site based Reception Manager you will be expected to chair and take minutes where necessary.

· Encourage a sustainable way of working, bringing forward innovative ways of working with sustainability being a key focus of how we deliver our welcome and services.

· Proactively engage and encourage team engagement with all Teams groups and channels, as well as taking a proactively leadership role in regards to innovations, activities and awards.

· Demonstrate an understanding of competitor and market activity outside of Savills FOH, focusing on best practice, innovation and community

MOBILE REQUIREMENT

· Attend internal and external meetings, mobilisations and recruitment drives, client meetings and welfare visits, and industry events.

· Respond to all emergency out-of-hours calls in a timely and efficient manner. The nature of the role is that shift patterns may go outside of your normal working hours so you are expected to be flexible at times for emergency situations and operational requirements in residential portfolios.

· Ensure all on site operational manuals are up to date.

· Assist with any other reasonable requests and tasks from senior management.

· Responsible for direct absence management, both operationally and ensuring all absence is correctly registered within the Cascade system.

RELATIONSHIPS

· Build and maintain relationships with the Building Management Teams, your colleagues and your teams.

· Communicate with your line manager and the HR Partner on all and any issues pertaining to HR and Training.

· Engage in constructive dialogue with direct reports and clients, employing positive challenges to achieve desired outcomes, and demonstrating the ability to navigate difficult conversations with influencing skills.

Candidates will be required to demonstrate the following:

· At least three years’ management experience within Front of House, luxury hospitality or a comparable premium service environment, including responsibility for multiple sites and teams.

· Strong leadership and people-management skills, with experience coaching and developing teams and managing employee relations matters.

· Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to build relationships and positively influence clients and business decisions.

· Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience managing budgets and portfolio P&Ls.

· A genuine passion for service excellence, with a positive, solutions-focused approach and high standards of professionalism.

· Highly organised and adaptable, with the ability to manage multiple sites, teams, clients and projects while maintaining excellent attention to detail.

* Mounting and Installation: Ability to mount and install network devices such as routers, switches, and servers in data centers and office locations. This includes rack mounting, cable management, and hardware configuration. Candidates must be able to lift network equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.

  + Frequent visits to Datacenter near Manchester.

If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you’d like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we’d like to talk to you.

## Job Description

We are looking for a hands-on PostgreSQL DBA to help manage database services across our on-premises infrastructure and GCP. The role combines production operations with project work, including migration from Community PostgreSQL to EDB Postgres, high-availability standardization, database consolidation, and operational automation.

You will work closely with DBAs, SRE, infrastructure, application, and security teams. We need someone who can assess the current environment, identify risks and improvements, recommend practical solutions, and follow them through to stable production operations.

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

* PostgreSQL and EDB administration. Administer the full database lifecycle, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, capacity planning, security, monitoring, incident response, and decommissioning.
* High availability with EFM. Configure, operate, monitor, and troubleshoot EDB Failover Manager clusters; perform planned switchovers and failover tests; validate application connectivity; and safely reintegrate failed or former primary nodes.
* Backup and recovery with Barman. Configure and monitor base backups and WAL archiving or streaming, manage retention, execute point-in-time recovery, and conduct documented restore and disaster-recovery tests against agreed RPO and RTO targets.
* Monitoring and alerting with PEM. Register and manage servers and agents, configure meaningful metrics and alert thresholds, investigate alerts and performance trends using graphs, and maintain notification and escalation integrations.
* Automation and version control. Use TPA and Ansible/Spacelift to build repeatable PostgreSQL/EDB environments and maintain playbooks and configuration in Git and GitHub using branches, pull requests, and peer review.
* Replication and recovery. Configure and troubleshoot physical streaming and logical replication, replication slots, WAL retention, lag, and timeline issues; use pg\_rewind when appropriate to resynchronize a node after timelines diverge.
* Performance engineering. Analyze execution plans and wait or lock behavior, tune SQL and indexes, and optimize PostgreSQL and operating-system settings, including autovacuum, memory, storage, and checkpoint or WAL behavior.
* Connectivity and security. Operate PgBouncer and manage roles, privileges, authentication, pg\_hba.conf, TLS, secrets, and least-privilege access in line with organizational standards.
* Migrations and consolidation. Plan and execute major and minor version upgrades, Community PostgreSQL-to-EDB migrations, and database consolidation with validated rollback, testing, and minimal downtime.
* Operational ownership. Create runbooks and architecture documentation, participate in change and incident processes, collaborate with engineering teams, and join an on-call rotation for production emergencies.
* Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

More information about this role:

This is a full-time and remote position based in the U.K. The target compensation package for this role is between GBP 50,000 and 54,000, subject upon internal equity and years of experience.  We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.

## Qualifications

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, technology, or a related field is strongly preferred. In lieu of degree, 2+ years of relevant and/or equivalent experience is acceptable.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 5+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration in production environments, including both routine operations and complex troubleshooting is required.
* Hands-on production experience with EDB Postgres, EFM, Barman, PEM, and TPA, along with PostgreSQL monitoring using Prometheus and Grafana.
* Strong understanding of PostgreSQL HA design, streaming replication, failure detection, switchovers, failovers, quorum or witness concepts, split-brain prevention, and node rejoin procedures.
* Demonstrated experience with backup validation, WAL archiving, retention management, point-in-time recovery, and full restore or disaster-recovery testing.
* Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL internals, including WAL, MVCC, vacuum and autovacuum, checkpoints, memory management, locking, and transaction behavior.
* Strong SQL performance-tuning skills, including EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), index design, query-plan analysis, and diagnosis of blocking or resource contention.
* Solid Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including CPU, memory, filesystem, storage I/O, systemd services, networking, and shell scripting.
* Strong hands-on experience with Ansible, Git, and GitHub, including playbooks, inventories, pull requests, peer review, conflict resolution, and version-controlled TPA configuration.
* Hands-on experience configuring, administering, and troubleshooting PgBouncer.
* Experience with GCP and/or AWS, including virtual machines, networking, storage, identity and access management, and cloud monitoring.
* Clear written and verbal communication, disciplined documentation, sound production judgment, and willingness to participate in an on-call rotation.

**Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience with comparable PostgreSQL tools such as Patroni, repmgr, pgBackRest, or pgWatch.
* Experience with Terraform and automation using Bash or Python.
* Previous involvement in large PostgreSQL migrations, major-version upgrades, database consolidation, or hybrid on-premises/cloud environments.
* Experience administering MariaDB or MySQL.
* You are a practical, accountable DBA who balances availability and data protection with delivery needs. You investigate carefully, communicate risk clearly, automate repeatable work, test recovery procedures rather than assuming they work, and remain calm during production incidents.

# Financial Crime and Investigation Fraud Investigator

## Financial Crime and Investigation Fraud Investigator

### Job Introduction

Role Responsibility:

 

As Financial Crime and Investigations Fraud Investigator - Cash you will support the Loss Prevention Strategy, Purpose and Vision by leading the accurate, timely and controlled reconciliation of retail cash across stores to identify and investigate cash loss and the causes of this loss.  Alongside this you will embed a culture of Financial Crime awareness throughout the business through training and internal communication, recognising that it is everyone’s responsibility to prevent Financial Crime occurring.

 

Key Purposes:

 

The Financial Crime and Investigation Fraud Investigator - Cash is responsible for ensuring all retail cash tender transactions are accurately reconciled and discrepancies investigated and resolved in line with company policy, financial controls and audit requirements. 

The role protects cash integrity, reduces operational risk, supports store teams, and provides clear insight into exceptions, trends and process improvements.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

* Lead the daily reconciliation of store cash takings.
* Ensure cash banking, till declarations, point-of-sale data, payment processor settlements and bank receipts are matched accurately and on time.
* Investigate discrepancies, shortages and overages, ensuring clear ownership and timely resolution.
* Lead HR investigations where discrepancies are linked to staff wrongdoing.
* Maintain robust reconciliation controls and exception reporting.
* Provide clear reporting on reconciliation performance, cash loss, trend analysis and control risks.
* Partner with store teams to improve cash handling discipline, till procedures, banking accuracy and compliance with operating standards.
* Escalate material variances, suspected fraud indicators, repeated process failures or control weaknesses to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Own and continuously improve reconciliation processes, standard operating procedures, system use and management information.

 

**The ideal candidate**

 

* Strong understanding of retail finance operations, cash office processes, sales audit, bank reconciliation and payment settlement cycles.
* Experience managing reconciliations in a high-volume retail environment.
* Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to identify root causes, challenge anomalies and translate data into practical action.
* Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with reconciliation systems, point-of-sale data, payment portals, banking platforms and finance systems.
* Strong control mindset, with awareness of fraud risk, loss prevention, audit requirements and financial governance.
* Experience in internal HR investigations and previous involvement in staff disciplinary procedures.
* Clear communicator who can work effectively with store colleagues, finance teams, technology partners and senior stakeholders.
* Highly organised, deadline-driven and able to manage competing priorities during daily close, month-end and peak trading periods.
* Relevant finance qualification, accounting experience or equivalent financial operations or investigation background is desirable.
* Tenacious, able to ensure that all avenues and lines of investigation are fully exhausted, especially in the face of challenge.
* Proactive, able to work on their own as well as with others in a team.

**About SINGU**

At **SINGU**, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become **Europe’s leading platform** for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

**Our unified CAFM platform** already powers the daily operations of **over 250 million m2 of real estate worldwide**, supporting more than **500,000 professionals.** Following our union with the UK’s **Micad** and Germany’s **net-haus,** we now help manage **100,000+ buildings** across **35+ countries** — and we’re just getting started.

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as **Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood,** **Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield.** As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: **adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.**

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — **join SINGU and be part of this transformation.**

## **About the Role**

You'll own a significant slice of the SINGU product suite: **space management and Soft FM services** – cleaning standards, portering, and catering – used every day primarily across the **UK healthcare market**. Product-market fit is established and thousands of users depend on these products daily. What the portfolio needs now is strategic direction and taking them to their next level of growth.

You'll do that through a **team of four Product Managers** who are domain experts in the products they run. This is a **hands-on leadership role**. You'll stay close to customer problems yourself, you'll raise the bar on how the team discovers and validates work, and you'll have real autonomy to decide what's worth building – and to prove it works.

SINGU group grows both organically and through acquisition, and several of these products arrived with the companies that built them. You'll shape the strategy for bringing them into **one coherent ecosystem** and lead your team through that change. If you enjoy taking a set of good but separate products and making them add up to something bigger, that is the interesting part of this job.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Engineering, and Product colleagues across the SINGU Group so your portfolio drives revenue and solves real problems across the European FM market. **AI is a must-have lever** in our industry rather than a talking point: you'll be applying it where it measurably improves how our customers run their estates.

This is a **remote position** **with periodic travel to London and Kraków** – roughly every two to four weeks.

## **Role Scope**

***People Leadership & Team Development:***

* **Manage and develop the Product Managers** within the product team.

* Own the full management lifecycle: **hiring, onboarding, mentorship, feedback, coaching, performance evaluations, promotions, and exits**.

* Foster a **high-performing product culture** based on customer empathy, data-driven decision-making, and outcome orientation.

* Manage staffing and focus areas across the suite, reallocating product resources where needed to balance discovery workload and meet strategic priorities.

* **Lead the team through change** – new ways of working, a shifting portfolio, and product consolidation – bringing people with you rather than around them.

***Product Discovery & Strategy:***

* **Define and maintain product roadmaps** aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and market trends.

* Decide **where to invest and where to hold**: set a clear, defensible position on which initiatives scale and communicate it across the business.

* Build strong **alignment with the Sales team** to ensure product discovery and roadmap priorities actively unblock deals and support revenue growth.

* Identify and resolve ambiguities, dependencies, and competing priorities that impact discovery quality and speed.

***Product Management Best Practices & Standards:***

* Promote modern product practices, including **continuous discovery, outcome-based roadmapping, and hypothesis-driven development**.

* Ensure product teams consistently validate assumptions through **user research, experimentation, and data analysis**.

* Drive improvements in requirements quality, stakeholder communication, prioritization frameworks, and release planning.

* Cooperate with the Chief Architect and Engineering Managers to ensure product decisions account for technical feasibility and platform constraints.

* Drive the adoption of **AI-powered tools and analytics** to improve product insights, customer understanding, and decision-making quality.

***Collaboration & Cross-Company Coordination:***

* Coordinate with commercial and customer-facing teams to align product strategy with **go-to-market plans and revenue goals** for the portfolio.

* Represent the company at **external events, conferences, and industry forums** to share product insights, build the Group's profile, and stay connected to market trends.

* Maintain alignment, knowledge sharing, and team cohesion with colleagues across the Group.

## **Experience & Requirements**

**Must have's:**

* **5+ years in product management**, ideally with at least three of them in **B2B SaaS**. Strong B2C experience in FM, healthcare, or an adjacent domain is also worth a conversation.

* **At least two years leading a team as a people manager** – product managers ideally, but we are flexible on the setup; what matters is that you have owned a team, not that you are ready to start.

* Experience taking a team or a product area through real change: new ways of working, a restructure, or **post-acquisition integration** – and bringing the sceptics with you.

* Demonstrable experience **applying AI within product development**, using AI-powered tooling to accelerate discovery and delivery.

* Proven track record of **leading product discovery** across multiple methods and translating insights into validated roadmaps.

* **Strong commercial awareness**: able to partner with Sales and align product decisions with revenue and retention goals.

* **Data fluency**: comfortable defining metrics, querying product analytics, and using quantitative evidence to drive decisions.

* **Excellent stakeholder communication**: able to frame trade-offs and build alignment across technical and non-technical audiences.

* **English at C1 or above**, written and spoken, with the confidence to represent the product externally.

**Nice to Have's:**

* Experience working in **empowered product trios** (or similar cross-functional squads) with engineering and design.

* Experience in **healthcare (ideally the UK market, NHS)**, public sector, or government-adjacent markets.

* Familiarity with **platform or multi-product portfolio environments**.

* Experience **integrating acquired products** into a single coherent platform.

* **Polish or German alongside English**.

Not sure you tick every box? If you are strong on product leadership and craft but light on one of the requirements, we would still like to hear from you.

## **Why Here**

* **Real ownership:** you own a portfolio and the team that runs it. Strategy, discovery, and outcomes are yours, not a backlog handed down to you.

* **Modern product culture:** we work in trios, practice continuous discovery, and ship to learn.

* **AI that makes sense:** you'll apply AI to a platform customers already rely on, where it measurably improves how they run their estates – not bolted on for its own sake.

* **A stable base for ambitious work:** SINGU is **profitable and growing**, with consistently stable results.

* **Growth:** SINGU keeps growing through acquisition, so new areas to consolidate and lead keep appearing.

* **International scope:** **five companies and around 250 people** across Poland, the UK, and Germany, with a portfolio that spans markets rather than one office.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

## The role

Tano helps some of the fastest-growing consumer brands build creator programmes that operate as real, scalable growth channels. We combine strategy, software and agentic AI to help brands activate, engage and retain thousands of creators through personalised, lifecycle-driven programmes: driving revenue, customer acquisition and a consistent supply of high-performing creative.

We're looking for an amazing Senior Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of these programmes.

This isn't a traditional account management role where success means keeping the client happy and delivering campaigns on time. **You'll own the strategy and performance of your accounts**: deeply understanding the client's business, identifying where the growth opportunities are, designing the creator programme around them and continually experimenting to improve performance.

You'll be part strategist, part operator and part account manager. You'll be comfortable moving between a client strategy session, interrogating programme data, designing a creator experiment and working with our product and AI infrastructure to execute it at scale.

Ultimately, we want you to treat each creator programme like a growth channel you own.

## What you'll do

### Own and grow your accounts

You'll own the day-to-day and strategic relationship with a portfolio of high-growth DTC brands.

That means understanding their business beyond the creator programme: their customer, product, growth model, commercial priorities and the role creators need to play within them.

You'll translate that into a clear programme strategy and be accountable for delivering against the client's objectives: whether that's new customer acquisition, revenue, creator-led content supply or generating creative for paid social.

You won't wait for clients to tell you what to do next. You'll identify the opportunity, build the recommendation and confidently lead them towards it.

### Build brilliant creator programmes

You'll design programmes that systematically drive the creator behaviours our clients need. That might mean:

* Identifying the creator niches and consumer communities most likely to drive incremental growth.
* Building creator personas around a brand's highest-value customer segments.
* Designing creator journeys from first activation through to repeat posting, sales and long-term advocacy.
* Developing gifting, incentive, commission and retention strategies.
* Identifying how and when creators should be re-engaged around product launches, seasonal moments and commercial priorities.
* Using Tano's agentic infrastructure to deliver personalised creator experiences across thousands of relationships.

We don't believe there's one blueprint for a successful creator programme, and the goalposts are always moving. You'll understand the psychology of the product and customer, then build the programme around the behaviours required to grow it.

### Turn data into decisions

You'll own the performance story for your accounts.

You'll know which metrics matter, which don't, and what the numbers are actually telling us.

Rather than reporting that creator activation increased 15%, you'll want to understand why it increased, what changed, whether we can replicate it and what we should do differently as a result.

You'll combine quantitative performance data with qualitative signals from creators and clients to identify opportunities others might miss.

And you'll communicate those insights simply and persuasively, whether that's in a weekly update or a strategic recommendation to a CMO.

### Experiment constantly

We're building a new category, so there often won't be an existing playbook. You'll form hypotheses, design experiments and use the results to continuously improve the programmes you own.

That could mean testing creator segments, gifting strategies, incentive structures, communication cadence, messaging, lifecycle interventions or hundreds of smaller variables that influence creator behaviour.

You understand that sometimes the biggest performance unlock is a sophisticated programme redesign, and sometimes it's changing a 200-word creator email to 50 words. **You're interested in both.**

### Shape what we build next

You'll work closely with product and engineering, a critical part of the job. You are closest to how these programmes actually run and what clients actually need, so the frameworks you build and the bottlenecks you hit feed directly into what we automate next.

## Who you are

* You're commercially minded and genuinely curious about how consumer businesses grow. You understand that creator marketing doesn't exist in isolation from the rest of a brand's marketing mix.
* You love performance DTC marketing, and you're excited by the idea of growing an influencer channel into something that genuinely moves the numbers.
* You love account management. You enjoy getting underneath a client's business, earning their trust and becoming the person they rely on to tell them what should happen next.
* You're analytical, but you're not a reporting machine. Data is useful to you because it helps you make better decisions. No data for data's sake.
* You're equally comfortable with the quantitative and qualitative. You can spot a pattern in a dataset, but you also understand that creator behaviour is human: messaging, timing, incentives, relationships and experience all matter.
* You're a builder. Ambiguity doesn't make you wait for instructions; it makes you start forming a hypothesis.
* You have a bias towards action. You'll make sensible decisions quickly, test them, learn and course-correct rather than endlessly seeking certainty.
* You're excited by what AI makes possible. You don't need to be technical, but you're interested in how agentic AI can fundamentally change the economics and scale of relationship-driven marketing.

## Your experience

We care more about how you think than having followed one specific career path.

You might have done a few years brand side (growth, ecommerce, creator marketing or CRM at a high-growth consumer brand) and be looking for a new avenue for growth. Or you might have done a stint at a performance agency managing accounts properly, and want to switch gears and join a tech company.

* 3+ years' experience in DTC/ecommerce, growth marketing, performance marketing, creator/affiliate marketing or performance-led agency account management.
* Strong commercial instincts and a good understanding of how DTC businesses acquire and retain customers.
* Experience owning a channel, account, programme or commercial workstream against measurable targets.
* Strong analytical skills and experience turning performance data into clear recommendations and actions.

Creator marketing has become very good at activation. Brands can find creators, gift them products, pay them and track their sales. **The harder problem is what happens next.**

How do you turn thousands of individual creator activations into long-term relationships? How do you get the right creator to take the right action at the right time? That's what we're building Tano to solve. We think creator programmes will increasingly operate like lifecycle and loyalty programmes: personalised, continuously optimised and designed around the behaviours that ultimately drive commercial outcomes.

Agentic AI makes it possible to do that across thousands of creator relationships. You'll be one of the people figuring out how.

# Senior Product Manager - Trading

OverviewApplication

**📈 Who We Are:**

**We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.**

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a **$75 million Series B -** led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

# **The Role:**

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager, Rosso.

This is the second product manager on Rosso, reporting into the Rosso Product Lead. Rosso is deeply technical, built on ML-led models and complex engineering covering forecasting, pricing optimisation and portfolio balancing, so this is a role for a technically-minded PM who's happiest closest to the hardest problems. You'll work on complex, important problems as they arise across the Rosso product surface, alongside the other PM on the team, rather than owning one fixed patch. In the near term that means the portfolio area: fulfilling and balancing a growing two-sided portfolio, managing imbalance, and finding the revenue and margin in every position we hold. It's still forming, it carries live financial risk, and it needs someone who wants to win in it.

You will:

* Take business and customer needs and turn them into feasible, shipped product, working closely enough to the ML and forecasting work to make good calls on it.
* Own the technical-product detail, setting clear success criteria for how well a model or forecast needs to perform, and designing for the edge cases and operational reality of a system carrying live financial risk.
* Drive open product decisions to a close - yours and the team's - so delivery keeps moving at pace, with a clear Now, Next and Future for the initiatives you own.

# 🚀 **Responsibilities:**

**Turn needs into shipped product**

* Take business and customer needs and turn them into feasible product execution, balancing them against nascent ML and forecasting innovations that push the frontier of what's possible.
* Take initiatives from discovery through to regularly released product, with a clear Now, Next and Future for a given area.
* Drive open product decisions to a close, so work keeps moving.
* Decide what to formalise, what stays a prototype and what to drop - be the editor and builder, not just the instigator.

**Own the technical-product detail**

* Work embedded in full-stack teams that include ML/data science and software engineers, close enough to the models to make good calls.
* Set clear success criteria for how well a model or forecast needs to perform for the product to work, and design for the edge cases and operational reality of a system that carries live financial risk.
* Pull and interrogate your own and others' data to influence and inform decisions, and reason about model performance and error as business indicators.
* Get close to the people who use what you build, from internal commercial teams to generators and businesses externally.

**Win in the portfolio**

* Concentrate, in the near term, on the portfolio area while it's still forming, without that becoming a permanent boundary on where you work.
* Treat hedging, imbalance and trading decisions as product decisions: when to hold a position, when to trade it out, when to reprice to close a gap in the portfolio.
* Find the tangible and most pressing problems worth solving - such as whether to buy or build a new forecasting capability, or how to ensure Rosso reacts at scale to any event in the system.
* Chase the commercial outcome, not just the shipped feature - the measure of this role is margin found and risk managed, at pace.

# 🎯 **Requirements:**

**Must haves**

* A product manager with real product execution behind them: owned at least one complex product area end to end, with a track record of moving real business outcomes, not just shipping features.
* Commercial drive. You set the pace for yourself and the people around you, push decisions to a close, and go after revenue and margin. You want to win, and it shows in how you work.
* Experience in or around trading. Energy trading is the ideal, but financial trading, fintech, battery or EV trading all count - you understand positions, hedging and what it means for a system to carry live financial risk.
* Uses data analysis throughout the product process, to validate ideas, progress work, and measure success.
* ML-literate: has worked closely enough with ML and data science to make good calls on model-led products, and can reason about model performance and error as business indicators.
* Built product in a startup, scaleup or other high-growth environment, with high personal ownership of an area.
* A strong instinct for failure points, edge cases and the operational reality of a live system.
* AI-native, AI-literate and AI-critical - you know where it helps and where it hurts.
* A clear, structured communicator, especially in writing.

**Bonus points**

* Hands-on energy trading experience - intraday, day-ahead, imbalance or battery optimisation.
* Experience where forecasting or fulfilling a two-sided marketplace is central to the product.
* Experience going through a third-party-access and/or international-expansion transition.
* Experience with regulated industries and data-heavy products.

# ✨ **Benefits & Perks:**

* Competitive salary - our current band for this role is £85,000-£93,000 or equivalent in local currency.
* Stock Options - everyone on the team has ownership in our mission.
* 25 days holiday + public holidays - Swap public holidays for ones that matter most to you. Plus, get an extra day off for your birthday 🎉.
* Remote & flexible working - We're fully remote with clear core hours, and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.
* Home working & wellbeing budgets:

  + Up to £1,200 / €1,200 annually to upgrade your remote setup (co-working passes, equipment, etc.).
  + Up to £150 / €150 monthly on anything that supports your wellbeing - from therapy to gym memberships to meditation apps.

# **🗣️ Interview Process:**

Our processes normally take around 2-3 weeks from first call to offer - please let us know about any adjustments to timelines that may be required.

1. **First call with our Talent Team (30 Mins).** This is to understand your experience, motivations, and discuss the role in more detail.
2. **Behaviour Interview with our Product Lead (45 Mins).** This is your chance to really understand the role, the expectations, and ensure alignment on ways of working.
3. **Technical Interview with the Team (75 Mins)**. You’ll meet with potential peers to discuss how you drive product execution, work closely with ML and engineering teams, and think through real product scenarios - built around a real product decision shaped by a model or forecast, so we're testing on proof, not assertion.
4. **Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders (45 Mins).** The final session will be with two cross-functional stakeholders, and will explore how your values align with ours, and is designed to be a genuine two-way conversation, your chance to understand what it’s really like to work at tem.

*We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.*

Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – Principal Engineer, CSRE Provisioning

Location: Remote, United Kingdom

Division: Ticketmaster

Contract Terms: Permanent, 40 hours per week

**THE TEAM**

A career at Ticketmaster will challenge and engage you. We support the creators and producers of shows and live performances, while connecting more passionate fans to these events. The pace here is fast, the atmosphere is fun and a passion for live events is a common thread that ties us together. As a global and growing business, we can truly offer a world of opportunities to expand your skills and develop your career. Visit any of our offices and you'll find a diverse mix of passionate employees, helping fans around the globe connect with the artists, teams and events they love. It truly is a unique and rewarding environment.

You will be part of the Provisioning team within CSRE (Customer/Client Site Resilience Engineering). Provisioning reduces operational complexity across the Ticketmaster hosted CSRE platform estate — we own the lifecycle of the platforms behind Resilience Engineering, operating, stabilising, standardising, upgrading, migrating and, where appropriate, retiring them.

The estate grew through years of pragmatic local decisions: inconsistent deployment patterns, patchy observability, ageing infrastructure. Our job is to reverse that. We are not measured by how much infrastructure we build — we are measured by how much complexity we remove, leaving a smaller, more consistent, more reliable estate that costs less to operate.

We support teams across the globe, with many peers in North America and the United Kingdom, and we are adding people in other time zones.

**THE JOB**

As a Principal Engineer in Provisioning, you will help set technical direction for how the CSRE hosted platform estate is operated, upgraded, migrated and retired. You will help sequence the largest and highest-risk initiatives, lead on the most complex work and act as a technical escalation point when things go wrong in production.

You will help define the operating standards other engineers enforce, resolve ownership questions before they become disputes, and represent Provisioning's technical position to other CSRE teams, application teams and senior leadership. You will multiply your impact through the engineers you develop, while staying hands-on with the platforms.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**

* Help set technical direction and a multi-quarter roadmap for platform lifecycle work across the CSRE hosted estate.
* Own the hardest and highest-risk initiatives, personally leading platform-side execution
* Help define and evolve Provisioning's supported operating model and standards, deciding what becomes standard versus a documented, time-boxed exception.
* Act as a technical escalation point for production incidents on platforms Provisioning operates, driving resilience analysis into durable, structural fixes.
* Represent Provisioning's technical position in cross-team architecture and design reviews with Platform Engineering, application teams, and senior leadership.
* Build and evolve the reliability, DR and observability practices used across the estate, going deeper than any single platform to ensure they generalize.
* Lead service acceptance for the most complex or highest-risk new platforms, setting the bar other engineers apply to the rest.
* Identify what infrastructure or process can be retired before advocating for anything new, consistent with the team's 'shrink before growing' principle.
* Participate in the team's on-call rotation and act as an escalation point for the most complex incidents — in line with our 'you build it, you run it' mantra, technical ownership at this level still means carrying the pager.
* Mentor and develop senior and staff-level engineers through pairing, design review and career coaching.
* Contribute to sprint planning and PI-cycle delivery on the PROV Jira board, shaping how capacity is split between planned improvement and reactive operational demand.
* Bring structural feedback from operating the estate back into CSRE Platform tooling and Provisioning's own standards.

**WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)**

* Extensive practical experience operating and evolving production infrastructure at scale, including complex, high-risk migrations and decommissioning.
* Deep expertise designing and troubleshooting distributed systems, with a track record of resolving the most complex cross-service failure modes.
* Expert understanding of SRE principles — SLIs, SLOs, error budgets — and how to apply them consistently across a large, heterogeneous estate.
* Extensive experience with on-premises data center infrastructure and cloud-native environments, including governance, cost trade-offs, and vendor evaluation at scale.
* Track record improving observability and alerting across many platforms, not just a single service.
* Deep experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation, with a bias toward making operational work repeatable rather than manual.
* Excellent software engineering fundamentals, with the judgment to know when a bespoke solution is warranted and when it isn't.
* Extensive experience with production readiness, DR validation, and controlled failure testing across critical systems.
* Expert-level incident analysis skills, with the ability to identify structural, contributing factors across multiple incidents.
* Practical experience directing where LLM and AI-assisted tooling helps engineering work, and where it does not.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including exec-ready summaries, architecture documents, and clear standards.

**YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)**

* Lead with service and humility, creating momentum without leaning on authority.
* Default to curiosity, asking how a team got where they are before prescribing a solution.
* Hold a point of view: ready to say "this is how we do it" and explain why, and just as ready to take a better idea back to platform leadership.
* Persuade with evidence and empathy, adapting your message for engineers, product, and senior stakeholders.
* Mentor deliberately, helping others grow as engineers and as people who support other engineers well.
* Give direct feedback with respect, and protect psychological safety while raising the bar.
* Stay patient in a complex organization, keeping work moving when dependencies are slow.
* Turn messy inputs into clear next steps without needing every detail resolved first.
* Prefer simple mechanisms that scale over bespoke fixes that only you can maintain.
* Work sustainably and design systems that do not require heroics to keep running.
* Take pride in the documentation and decisions that let teams sustain the work.
* Remain adaptable, switching between hands-on debugging and engineering, customer support, and planning as needed.

**LIFE AT TICKETMASTER**

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

**Our work is guided by our values:**

**Reliability** - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

**Teamwork** - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team

**Integrity** - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

**Belonging** - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES**

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. **About the Role**

Tipalti is building an AI-native product to help with end of month accounts. Today, closing the books takes 5–6 accountants roughly 14 working days, chasing down discrepancies across spreadsheets, payroll systems, invoices, and disconnected data sources. This product is being built from scratch to automate large parts of that reconciliation work using AI, not as an add-on to an existing process, but as the product's core design principle from day one.

This is a hands-on Engineering Manager role: writing code, shaping product direction, talking to customers, and managing two exceptional engineers. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage from a distance. You'll be in the discovery calls, in the codebase, and in the room when the team decides what to build next.

The team operates with very few conventional handoffs between product, design, engineering, and customer-facing work. You'll be expected to run it that way too: make decisions with incomplete information, move fast, and treat mistakes as inputs rather than setbacks.


**What You'll Do**

* Lead and grow a team of 2 engineers, staying hands-on as a contributor while providing the direction and developing and metoring.
* Own a substantial part of the Close product end to end from discovery through implementation to delivery.
* Talk directly to customers and accountants, running discovery, demoing work live, and turning what you hear into a working product.
* Build and ship, personally contributing to the codebase and to the AI workflows at the heart of the product.
* Investigate real accounting processes (payroll, invoices, expenses, deferred amounts, reconciliation) across US and European operations to find where AI can remove manual, cross-referencing work.
* Represent the team's progress to stakeholders and sponsors, since the team operates with minimal formal reporting structure.
* Help define how a small, autonomous, AI-native team should operate at Tipalti, in a way that could be adopted more broadly if the model succeeds.

About Us
We're a company running 7–8 figure DTC brand portfolios operating across the US, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Our growth runs through paid social - Meta and TikTok at a serious scale, which means video is at the center of everything we do. We produce a high volume of UGC-style and direct-response ad creative, and we need editors who can keep up without the output quality slipping.
This isn't a passion project or a content agency. The creatives we edit run as paid ads, and the numbers tell us immediately what's working and what isn't. If you're the kind of designer who gets better with every round of feedback and wants to understand why something performs, not just how it looks, this is the environment for you.
We operate across multiple brands and categories, which means that, if needed, our designers must be able to switch between brand voices and audience types, without losing quality or pace.
The Role
You'll be designing static and graphic ad creatives for paid social, alongside supporting brand design needs across our portfolio. Your primary output is performance creative – e.g., Meta static ads, carousels, and graphic overlays.
You'll work from briefs produced by our creative strategists. Design here isn't done in a silo; it's part of a broader creative system, and your output needs to plug into that system cleanly.
What You'll Be Doing
Core Design- Performance Creative
• Designing static ad creatives for Meta (scroll-stopping, direct-response focused, and built to perform against real audiences)
• Producing carousels, product feature graphics, offer visuals, and hook-led image ads across multiple brand styles
• Ensuring every asset is on-brand: correct typography, color usage, visual hierarchy, and tone
Secondary- Brand & Campaign Design
• Supporting campaign and promotional design: sale banners, offer graphics, seasonal creative, and launch assets
• Contributing to product imagery and brand visual assets across the portfolio as needed
• Designing supporting assets for landing pages in collaboration with the Web Designer and CRO team
• Maintaining and evolving brand design systems and asset libraries as the portfolio grows
• Occasionally supporting internal design needs — decks, documents, or materials that represent the brand externally
Must-Haves
• A portfolio that includes DTC or direct-response graphic ad creative - we want to see designs that were made to perform, not just to look good
• Proficiency in Figma and Photoshop, Canva, and AI image tools - these are our primary tools and you need to be fast in both
• Strong grasp of visual hierarchy, typography, and layout as performance tools, you understand why a design works, not just how to make it look clean
• Ability to work across multiple brand identities
• Reliable, consistent output- you can handle concurrent briefs and hit deadlines without the quality slipping
• Comfortable in a feedback-driven environment - revision rounds are part of production, not a sign something went wrong
Strong Advantages
• Experience designing for DTC beauty, wellness, or lifestyle brands
• Familiarity with AI design tools that accelerate production without replacing craft
• Basic understanding of copywriting and how headline and visual work together — you don't just drop in copy, you consider it as a design element
• Experience with motion graphics or simple animated assets for social
• Understanding of conversion-focused design principles — how design choices influence buyer behaviour
Instant No's
• Your portfolio is editorial, print-heavy, or brand identity focused with no paid social or performance creative - that's a different discipline
• You treat briefs as loose suggestions - briefs are precise and exist for a reason; deviating without flagging it causes problems downstream
• You work in isolation - this role requires active collaboration with strategists, and team leads
Compensation & Benefits
• Competitive monthly rate (contractor) based on experience and portfolio quality
• Clear growth path: Graphic Designer → Senior Graphic Designer
• Fully remote - no fixed location, flexible setup
• Learning & development budget
• Access to winning ad references and a structured feedback system that actually makes you better

# **About Vantage**

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

## **Product Department**

The Product team at Vantage defines and stewards our global product platform: the customer outcomes we aim to deliver, the standards and reference approaches that make delivery repeatable, and the closed-loop learning that turns each deployment into an upgrade for the next. We do this in partnership with Engineering, Delivery, Operations, Procurement, Sustainability, Sales, Site Selection, and Business Development, aligning priorities and trade-offs while preserving clear functional ownership for design execution, construction delivery, and site operations.

## **Position Overview**

Vantage is building a repeatable, product-led approach to delivering hyperscale infrastructure and operating data centers on a global scale. We are hiring a Senior Manager, Product Performance Benchmarking to establish and evolve the product performance benchmarking capability at the heart of that approach. The benchmarking engine is the governed reference for our products across the full lifecycle, regions, and customer configurations, and will sit behind pricing, RFP responses, and executive reporting for a growing global portfolio.

It evaluates the expected schedule, cost, and sustainability of our products across design, delivery, and operations: how long they should take to build, and what they should cost to build and to run.

This is a senior individual contributor role expected to grow into team leadership for someone who combines deep benchmarking, estimating, preconstruction, and project controls experience with the commercial judgement to lead methodology, challenge conventions, and turn data into decisions. You will define what the benchmark should answer, how it is governed, how it is used in decisions, and how internal and external inputs become a durable capability.

## **What You Will Own**

You will build the product performance intelligence capability behind Vantage’s global data center platform. This is not a reporting role. It is a chance to define how one of the fastest-scaling infrastructure companies measures cost, schedule, sustainability, lifecycle performance, and value realization across regions, product configurations, and customer requirements.

The benchmark you build will shape real decisions: how products are configured, how products translate into cost, schedule, and sustainability impacts, how trade-offs are made, where performance is improving, and where the business needs to change. You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Delivery, Operations, Procurement, Sustainability, and Analytics, with visibility to senior leaders and direct influence over how Vantage becomes more repeatable, data-driven, and product-led.

## **What You Will Do**

* Define the governed benchmarking methodology, baseline assumptions, performance measures, and usage rules Vantage applies globally to configure, cost, schedule, approve, manage, and measure project performance across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Operations, and Sustainability.
* Own the benchmark roadmap across platform, product, regional baselines, configurations, and future product extensions.
* Translate Product, Procurement, Preconstruction, Project Controls, and Sustainability requirements into benchmark scope.
* Lead consultant engagement, reviewing methodology, assumptions, confidence bands, and deliverables.
* Own the WBS/CBS and schedule structure from a product, business-adoption, and use perspective.
* Govern baseline, regional variant, configuration bridge, and factor-pack logic.
* Partner with key stakeholders to incorporate market intelligence, supplier input, and realized cost factors into benchmark updates where appropriate.
* Define target audiences, provide business interpretation, and set reporting requirements for benchmark outputs to senior stakeholders, while partnering with analytics roles on dashboard build and data automation.
* Decide when benchmark outputs are fit for use in RFPs, ROM business cases, customer discussions, product decisions, and executive reporting.
* Own what decisions the benchmark enables and state clearly where confidence is insufficient.

## **What Success Looks Like**

* A governed product performance benchmark model exists that connects capital cost, schedule, sustainability and operational cost (energy, efficiency, maintainability) into a single governed reference with explicit methodology, confidence bands, and stated limits.
* Standardized KPIs and performance criteria are set, with the ability to reliably compare projects across approved variants, regions, and product versions from pre-construction through operations.
* Benchmark outputs are used in real decisions — RFPs, ROM business cases, customer discussions, product trade-offs, and executive reporting — under clear fitness-for-use rules.
* The WBS/CBS and schedule structures are adopted by Product, Procurement, Preconstruction, Project Controls, and Sustainability, and held under company change control.
* Baseline, regional variant, configuration bridge, and factor-pack logic is coherent and current, with refresh cycles running on a disciplined cadence.
* Benchmarking exists as a durable internal capability that gets better with data from each delivery project. Results inform enhancements to products, variants, and project delivery to continuously improve.
* Methodology, models, and refresh are owned in-house, with external inputs from consultants, market data, and suppliers integrated deliberately rather than relied upon by default.
* Senior stakeholders receive interpretation, not just numbers: what moved, why, and what decision it supports.

## **What We Are Looking For**

* Benchmarking and cost intelligence: 8–12 years in cost management, quantity surveying, preconstruction, owner’s representative, project controls, infrastructure benchmarking, or equivalent capital-project performance role. Exceptional candidates with fewer years of experience may be considered.
* Capital project modeling: Demonstrated experience building or governing cost, schedule, or TCO models for complex capital programs, including unit rates, quantities, escalation, regional factors, configuration deltas, and confidence ranges.
* Lifecycle performance orientation: Ability to connect capital cost, schedule, energy, operational cost, maintainability, and sustainability factors into a decision-ready view of product performance.
* Continuous learning: Experience comparing benchmarks to actual delivery outcomes and translating variance into actionable recommendations for design, procurement, delivery, or product roadmap decisions.
* Commercial decision support: Proven ability to use benchmarking outputs to inform RFPs, ROM business cases, customer discussions, pricing, procurement strategy, or executive trade-off decisions.
* Governance and adoption: Experience establishing standards, methodologies, or controls that multiple functions or regions were expected to adopt.
* Consultant and stakeholder leadership: Credibility to challenge external consultants, internal customers, and senior stakeholders on assumptions, methodology, and fitness for use.
* Data partnership: Working knowledge of structured data, reporting requirements, dashboards, or analytics workflows, with ability to partner with data teams without needing to personally own BI engineering.
* Communication: Ability to explain assumptions, movement, confidence levels, limits, and recommended decisions clearly to technical, commercial, and executive audiences.

### **Preferred**

* Experience with capital projects, construction, infrastructure, data centers, utilities, natural resources, or other mission critical domains, particularly in estimating, cost control, or owner’s representative environments.
* Experience building a benchmarking or cost-intelligence capability from scratch, not just operating an established PMO or cost function.
* Track record integrating operational and energy costs into capital benchmarking.
* Experience influencing pricing, bid, or investment decisions with benchmark data at executive levels.
* Experience using early design studies, spatial test fits, and configuration comparisons to quantify how site, layout, product, or customer-driven choices affect benchmarked cost, schedule, and lifecycle performance.
* Exposure to structured data environments, cost databases, estimating platforms, project controls, and BI tools; working alongside data teams to productize a model.
* Multi-region or global portfolio experience in procurement, supplier intelligence, benchmarking, or should-cost modeling including normalization of currency, tax/local conditions, regulations, and supply chain factors.
* Chartered status (for example MRICS) or equivalent professional standing.

**Role Purpose**

The Material Controller is responsible for the safe, efficient, and accurate management of all project materials received into the main site yard. The role ensures materials are inspected, recorded, stored, controlled, and distributed to tower locations and construction teams in line with project requirements.

The Material Controller plays a critical role in maintaining material availability, minimising losses, and ensuring the construction programme is supported through effective logistics and inventory management.

---

**Key Responsibilities**

**Material Receipt & Inspection**

* Coordinate and manage all deliveries arriving at the main project yard.
* Verify delivered materials against purchase orders, delivery notes, and project requirements.
* Inspect materials for quantity, quality, damage, and compliance with specifications.
* Record and report any shortages, defects, damages, or discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate records of all incoming deliveries.

**Inventory Management**

* Establish and maintain an accurate inventory control system.
* Track material movements from receipt through to final installation.
* Conduct regular stock checks and cycle counts.
* Monitor stock levels and notify the Construction Manager and Procurement Team of shortages or replenishment requirements.
* Ensure full traceability of project materials where required.

**Material Storage**

* Ensure materials are stored safely and securely within the yard.
* Maintain organised storage locations to allow rapid identification and retrieval of materials.
* Protect materials from damage, deterioration, theft, or environmental exposure.
* Ensure compliance with site safety, environmental, and quality requirements.

**Material Distribution & Logistics**

* Plan and coordinate the distribution of materials from the main yard to tower locations and work fronts.
* Liaise with Site Supervisors, Engineers, and Construction Management to understand upcoming material requirements.
* Schedule delivery vehicles and lifting resources to support programme requirements.
* Ensure materials arrive at work locations safely, on time, and in the correct quantities.
* Maintain records of all material issues and transfers.

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate material registers and inventory records.
* Manage delivery notes, goods received records, material issue notes, and transfer documentation.
* Produce regular reports on stock levels, material usage, outstanding deliveries, and logistics performance.
* Support project audits and quality inspections by providing material traceability records.

**Health, Safety & Environmental Compliance**

* Ensure all yard activities are carried out in accordance with company and project safety procedures.
* Support safe loading, unloading, lifting, and transportation of materials.
* Maintain good housekeeping standards within the yard.
* Report safety concerns, near misses, and incidents promptly.
* Comply with environmental and waste management requirements.

---

* Construction Manager
* Site Managers and Supervisors
* Logistics Providers
* Quality Team
* Plant and Transport Coordinators
* Suppliers and Delivery Contractors

* Strong organisational and planning skills.
* Experience managing inventory records and material tracking systems.
* Good understanding of delivery documentation and stock control procedures.
* Competent in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to prioritise workload in a fast-paced construction environment.

**Desirable**

* Forklift or telehandler operator certification.
* Knowledge of ERP or materials management systems.
* Understanding of quality and material traceability requirements.

Remote, supporting clients in the United States and the United Kingdom. Delivery operations start early, so some days begin before dawn.

Remote. Small team, direct ownership, no layers between you and the decisions.

We are seeking a hands-on, execution-driven Mid-Level UX/UI Designer to join our growing product team on a 12-month fixed-term maternity leave cover. This role is focused on building and owning the end-to-end UX workflow: transforming validated product hypotheses into intuitive, high-quality interaction designs that meet real user needs.
You'll focus on translating well-defined product problems into clean, usable, component-based designs. You'll work closely with PMs and engineers to ensure we deliver intuitive, usable solutions—fast, consistently, and with craft. You'll also help strengthen our philosophy of simplicity by applying core UX principles to improve usability across the product.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Design execution and craft
Translate user needs and validated product ideas and requirements into wireframes, flows, and polished UI components
Own the design process from concept through handoff to engineering, ensuring clarity, consistency, and usability
Build UX that scales—your work should hold up across mobile and desktop, new users and power users, in any language
Work within and contribute to an evolving component-based design system
Conduct or support user research and usability testing; synthesize insights into actionable improvements
Design process and infrastructure
Establish and maintain a structured Figma workspace and design architecture
Build out a scalable design library and visual style guide to ensure design consistency that aligns with brand guidelines
Collaborate with other designers and engineers to evolve and optimize how we work and document design decisions
Cross-functional collaboration
Collaborate closely with Product Managers to deeply understand the problem and shape problem statements and solution spaces
Work directly with engineers to ensure accurate implementation of your designs
Participate in design iterations, rapid prototyping, user testing, QA handoffs, and cross-functional reviews
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
4+ years of experience designing digital products or SaaS applications
Strong interaction design skills and deep understanding of usability best practices
Fluency in Figma and component-driven design systems
A portfolio that demonstrates the ability to translate product intent into functional, user-first design
Comfortable managing own workload and maintaining velocity in a remote, async team
Comfortable testing and using AI solutions to accelerate design
Must have an existing suitable homeworking set-up in place
Must have the right to work in the UK (we are unable to offer sponsorship)
Must be available immediately or with a notice period of a month or less
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Experience in EdTech, education platforms, or creator tools
Familiarity with implementing and documenting design libraries
Experience working closely with PMs and engineers in delivery-focused environments
Understanding of user-centred design, user testing, rapid prototyping, and QA workflows
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
You prioritize usability and optimal user experience in your design
You consistently deliver high-quality UX work across product surfaces
You contribute to a clean, maintainable Figma environment alongside an organization-wide design system
You ensure consistent branding throughout the end-to-end user journey
Engineers rely on your specs and annotations to build efficiently
30 days' holiday per year (inclusive of UK bank holidays)
100% remote working #LI-Remote
Social events and annual meet ups
